questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Barbados?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Barbados article.

questions.proof: Its capital and largest city is Bridgetown.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Barbados?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Barbados article.

questions.proof: The official language of Barbados is English.
